title: Different observations find a shared rule

captions.physics: Considering differences and sharing a conclusion
captions.emotions: Feeling supported by a shared principle

meaning: Your shared view can find an understandable principle when independent reflection connects different aspects of observed experience.
text: A shared principle sometimes becomes visible through bringing two different observations together. The Hermit in the physical position of Ajna suggests considering differences and sharing a clear conclusion. Temperance in energy supports wanting to connect aspects of understanding while preserving their features. The Hierophant in emotions feels supported by a shared principle. You may enjoy an explanation having an understandable form and actually describing the material. Your view connects particular details with a rule accessible to both without excluding either initial impression.

For example, you examine pages of music for an unfamiliar tune. One person notices a repeated pattern while the other sees the final symbols change. Reflection reveals how variation preserves a recognisable foundation. **A shared principle can connect difference with repetition.** Both see how the observations relate. It feels pleasing that explanation names a familiar form while preserving change’s significance. You no longer need to decide whether the passages are identical or different: each is described in relation to the whole and a shared principle makes that relationship understandable.

The risk is making the discovered rule a requirement to see the same order in every subsequent passage. New observations are then fitted to a convenient form. Wanting connections between different aspects preserves openness: a principle explains the noticed relationship while other material may still require another arrangement.
